layout.intro_description:
Triple J Agro Farm needed durable farm buildings that could stand up to daily use, cleaning and the demands of livestock. Snow Holdings delivered the construction works on site, taking the structures from ground works through to roofed, usable farm housing.

The project shows the kind of practical, hard-wearing construction a working farm depends on: strong foundations, a robust frame, and floors and walkways built for heavy daily use.

image.alt: Triple J Agro Farm Development — photo 2

layout.approach_description:
We started with setting out and excavation, then built the foundations and ground beams that carry the structure. Steel columns were erected on the foundations to form the frame, followed by the roof structure and roofing.

Inside, we laid concrete floors and walkways, and formed channels to help keep the housing clean and drained. Our team supervised the work on site throughout, coordinating each stage so the next could follow without delay.
